meta.title: OpenSpec
meta.description: Six on-demand OpenSpec core skills packaged from OpenSpec 1.15.0 (MIT, Fission-AI/OpenSpec) plus a read-only right-sidebar panel: a workspace header with Explore and Propose composer drafts, counted Changes, Specs and Archive segments, change cards whose fixed numeric task-count gutter sits beside a two-line purpose and one facts row (phase, spec verdict, live review state, review coverage) over one navigation row carrying the artifact entries and both Apply and Archive actions with the inapplicable one disabled and explained, archived cards keeping their date and git commit, structured requirement and scenario cards, a spec History timeline of producing archived changes, a searchable archive, and read-only change tabs; requires the openspec CLI on PATH (npm install -g @fission-ai/openspec@1.15.0); specs stay in each workspace's own openspec/ root
